items.title: SV / SVO / SVC 的判定
items.brief: 先判系动词，再判有无宾语，两步定型

concept.summary: 判定顺序固定为两步：先看谓语动词是否系动词，是则 SVC；不是系动词再看动词后有没有宾语，无宾语是 SV，有宾语是 SVO。SVC 与 SVO 的区别不在「后面有没有东西」，而在「这个东西是不是主语本身」。

sections.p: 第一步判断动词性质，第二步判断成分数量。顺序不能颠倒，否则会把系动词后的表语误当宾语，把不及物动词后的状语误当宾语。
bullets: 系动词 → SVC：be, become, seem, look, feel, taste, smell, sound, remain, stay, keep, turn, grow, get
不及物动词 + 无宾语 → SV：happen, arrive, rise, lie, occur, exist, collapse, disappear
及物动词 + 一个宾语 → SVO：make, build, discuss, admire, mention, destroy
状语不算宾语：The train arrived at the station.（at the station 是地点状语）

sections.h: SVC 与 SVO 的分界
sections.p: 表语与主语指同一对象或同一状态，因此可以互换位置而意义基本不变；宾语与主语是两个不同对象，不能互换。这条互换测试是区分二者的唯一可靠标准。
bullets: The winner is Tom. = Tom is the winner.（表语，SVC）
He wrote the book. → × The book is him.（宾语，主语与宾语不同指）
She became a lawyer. → She was a lawyer.（表语与主语同指，SVC）
He looks tired. → He is tired.（表语说明主语状态）

sections.p: 部分动词既可作系动词也可作及物动词，判定依据是后面接的成分性质：接形容词是系动词，接名词性宾语是及物动词。
bullets: The soup tastes good.（系动词 + 表语）/ He tasted the soup.（及物动词 + 宾语）
She looked at the painting.（look at 是及物短语动词）/ She looked happy.（系动词）
They grow rice here.（种植，及物）/ The weather is growing cold.（变得，系动词）
被动语态是 SVO 的变体（宾语提到主语位置），不是新的句型

examples.en: The audience applauded enthusiastically.
examples.zh: 观众热情地鼓掌。
examples.note: applaud 在此为不及物动词，副词作状语，构成 SV。

examples.en: The train arrived at the station on time.
examples.zh: 火车准时到站。
examples.note: arrive 是不及物动词，at the station 与 on time 都是状语，句子是 SV。

examples.en: She became a lawyer after graduation.
examples.zh: 她毕业后成了一名律师。
examples.note: become 是系动词，a lawyer 与主语同指，是表语，构成 SVC。

examples.en: The company launched a new product last month.
examples.zh: 公司上个月推出了一款新产品。
examples.note: launch 是及物动词，a new product 是宾语，last month 是状语，构成 SVO。

examples.en: They arrived the airport at noon.
examples.zh: 他们中午到达机场。
examples.note: arrive 是不及物动词，不能直接带宾语，须说 arrive at the airport。

examples.en: The soup tastes deliciously.
examples.zh: 这汤尝起来很美味。
examples.note: taste 在此为系动词，后接形容词 delicious 作表语，不能用副词。

examples.en: He looked at the painting for a long time.
examples.zh: 他盯着那幅画看了很久。
examples.note: look at 是及物短语动词，the painting 是宾语，构成 SVO。

pitfalls.wrong: The accident was happened last night.
pitfalls.why: happen 是不及物动词，没有宾语也就没有被动语态，过去式本身作谓语。
resemble 是及物动词，直接带宾语，不需要介词 to。

pitfalls.right: His job is to teach English.
pitfalls.why: 表语位置不能放动词原形，须用不定式或动名词使其名词化。

contrast.diff: SVO 只有一个宾语；动词后再出现一个名词时，要判断它是第二宾语还是宾补，句型随之升级为 SVOO 或 SVOC。

concept.mnemonic: 先问是不是系动词，再问后面有没有宾语；有是 SVO，没有是 SV，系动词就是 SVC。

core: 第一步判系动词 → SVC；第二步判有无宾语 → SV / SVO
SVC 的表语与主语同指可互换；SVO 的宾语与主语不同指
不及物动词不能直接带宾语，须借助介词
look / taste / grow 等词有系动词与实义动词两副面孔
被动语态是 SVO 的变体，不是第六种基本句型
review.trigger: 看到动词先问「是不是系动词」，再问「后面有没有宾语」，两步定型

quickCheck.q: The train arrived at the station 属于哪种句型？
quickCheck.a: SV，at the station 是地点状语不是宾语。

quickCheck.q: The winner is Tom 为什么是 SVC？
quickCheck.a: is 是系动词，Tom 与 the winner 同指，可互换位置。

drills.stem: The meeting ___ at nine o'clock and lasted nearly two hours.
drills.explain: begin 在此为不及物动词，用主动形式表示「开始」，与 lasted 并列，构成 SV 句型。
drills.trap: was begun 把不及物动词误作及物动词变被动，英语中 begin 表示「开始」时没有这种被动形式。

drills.stem: The leaves ___ (turn) yellow when autumn comes.
drills.hint: yellow 是形容词，说明空格处的动词应为系动词。
drills.explain: turn 在此是系动词，后接形容词 yellow 作表语，构成 SVC；主语 leaves 为复数，用原形 turn。

drills.stem: They arrived the airport two hours before the flight.
drills.answer: They arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
accept: They arrived at the airport two hours before the flight.
drills.explain: arrive 是不及物动词，不能直接带宾语，须加介词 at 构成地点状语，句型为 SV。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: The company launched a new product last month.
drills.explain: launch 是及物动词，a new product 是宾语，last month 是时间状语，整体为 SVO。

drills.stem: 他毕业后成了一名律师。
drills.answer: He became a lawyer after graduation.
drills.explain: become 是系动词，a lawyer 是表语，与主语 he 同指，构成 SVC；表语是单数可数名词，须加不定冠词。

drills.stem: The cake ___ delicious, so everyone asked for the recipe.
drills.explain: taste 在此是系动词，后接形容词 delicious 作表语，构成 SVC，且不能变为被动语态。
drills.trap: was tasted 把系动词当成及物动词变被动，系动词没有被动形式。

items.title: SVOO / SVOC 的判定
items.brief: 两个名词之间加 be，成立即 SVOC

concept.summary: 动词后出现两个成分时，用插入 be 测试：第一个成分 + be + 第二个成分成立，则是 SVOC（宾语 + 宾补）；不成立但能改写为「动词 + 直接宾语 + to/for + 间接宾语」，则是 SVOO。SVOO 的两个宾语各自独立，SVOC 的补足语依附于宾语。

sections.p: 间接宾语通常是人，直接宾语是物。两个宾语可以互换位置，但间接宾语要改成介词短语：表示方向用 to，表示服务用 for。插入 be 一定不成立。
bullets: to 类：give, send, show, tell, teach, lend, pass, hand, offer, promise, award
for 类：buy, fetch, bring, make, cook, get, order
She gave me a ticket. = She gave a ticket to me.
He bought his son a bike. = He bought a bike for his son.

sections.p: 宾补与宾语之间有逻辑主谓关系，插入 be 后能构成一个合理命题。补足语一旦删去，句子语义不完整，这是它与状语的关键差别。
bullets: They named the baby Tom. → The baby is Tom.
We found the plan workable. → The plan is workable.
I want you to stay. → You stay.
The news left everyone speechless. → Everyone was speechless.

sections.p: 汉语里能说「告诉我一件事」的动词，英语中未必能接双宾语。explain, suggest, describe, announce, introduce, report 必须用 to 引出接受者，写成 动词 + 直接宾语 + to + 人。
bullets: × explain me the rule → √ explain the rule to me
× suggest us a plan → √ suggest a plan to us
× describe me the scene → √ describe the scene to me
√ tell me a story（tell 可带双宾语）

examples.en: The teacher showed us her new plan.
examples.zh: 老师给我们看了她的新方案。
examples.note: us 与 her new plan 是两个独立宾语，可改写为 showed her new plan to us，是 SVOO。

examples.en: The teacher made us rewrite the essay.
examples.zh: 老师让我们重写这篇文章。
examples.note: us 与 rewrite 有逻辑主谓关系（We rewrote the essay），是 SVOC。

examples.en: They considered the proposal impractical.
examples.zh: 他们认为这个提议不切实际。
examples.note: The proposal is impractical 成立，impractical 是宾补，是 SVOC。

examples.en: He lent me his car for the weekend.
examples.zh: 他把车借给我用了一个周末。
examples.note: lend 可带双宾语，可改写为 lent his car to me，是 SVOO。

examples.en: She explained me the rule.
examples.zh: 她给我解释了这条规则。
examples.note: explain 不能带双宾语，须改为 explained the rule to me。

examples.en: The news made us happily.
examples.zh: 这个消息让我们很高兴。
examples.note: 宾补须用形容词 happy 说明宾语的状态，happily 是副词，不能作宾补。

examples.en: He asked me a difficult question.
examples.zh: 他问了我一个很难的问题。
examples.note: ask sb sth 是 SVOO；注意 ask sb to do 才是 SVOC，同一个动词可属不同句型。

pitfalls.right: He suggested a solution to me.
pitfalls.why: suggest 不能带双宾语，接受者必须用介词 to 引出。

pitfalls.wrong: They elected him the chairman of the committee.
pitfalls.right: They elected him chairman of the committee.
pitfalls.why: 表示独一无二职位的名词作宾补时不加定冠词。

pitfalls.wrong: The teacher let us to leave early.
pitfalls.right: The teacher let us leave early.
pitfalls.why: let 是使役动词，作宾补的不定式省略 to。

contrast.diff: SVO 只有一个宾语；SVOO 是两个独立宾语，SVOC 是宾语加依附于它的补足语，三者靠插入 be 与介词改写区分。

concept.mnemonic: 中间加 be 通就是 SVOC，能改成 to/for 就是 SVOO，两样都不通就只有一个宾语。

core: 插入 be 成立 → SVOC；可改写为 to/for 介词短语 → SVOO
SVOO 常用动词：give, send, show, tell, teach, lend, pass, buy, offer
SVOC 常用动词：make, let, have, keep, find, consider, elect, call, see, hear, ask, want
to 表方向（give sb sth），for 表服务（buy sb sth）
explain / suggest / describe 不能带双宾语，须用 to 引出接受者
review.trigger: 动词后出现两个名词，先在中间插一个 be 试一次，再决定是 SVOC 还是 SVOO

quickCheck.q: They named the baby Tom 属于哪种句型？
quickCheck.a: SVOC，The baby is Tom 成立。

quickCheck.q: buy sb sth 改写时用 to 还是 for？
quickCheck.a: 用 for，buy a bike for his son。
不能，只能说 suggest sth to sb。

drills.stem: She ___ me her notes so that I could prepare for the exam.
drills.explain: lend 可带双宾语，构成 lend sb sth，即「把某物借给某人」，是 SVOO。
drills.trap: borrow 表示「借入」，方向相反，且只能说 borrow sth from sb，不能带双宾语。

drills.stem: The teacher asked us ___ (hand) in our essays by Friday.
drills.hint: ask 不属于使役动词，注意宾补中 to 的去留。
drills.explain: ask sb to do sth 是 SVOC 结构，宾补用带 to 的不定式；ask sb sth 才是 SVOO。

drills.stem: She explained me the whole process in detail.
drills.answer: She explained the whole process to me in detail.
accept: She explained the whole process to me in detail.
drills.explain: explain 不能带双宾语，只能构成 explain sth to sb，接受者由介词 to 引出。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.explain: the proposal 是宾语，impractical 是宾补，The proposal is impractical 成立，故为 SVOC。

drills.stem: 他给我看了他的新设计。
drills.answer: He showed me his new design.
forbid: showed to me his new design
showed his new design for me
drills.explain: show 可带双宾语，构成 show sb sth（SVOO）；若改用介词结构，须写成 showed his new design to me，方向介词用 to。

drills.stem: The manager had the report ___ before the meeting began.
drills.explain: have sth done 中过去分词作宾补，report 与 rewrite 是被动关系，即「让人把报告重写」，是 SVOC。
drills.trap: rewrite 会让 report 变成动作的发出者，报告不会自己重写，逻辑关系不成立。

items.title: 基本句型的扩展与转换
items.brief: 加修饰语只是扩展，换成分位置才是转换

concept.summary: 扩展只增加修饰或并列成分，不改变核心句型的骨架；转换是同一意义在句型之间移动成分，如 SVOO 变 SVO + 介词短语、SVOC 变宾语从句、定语从句变分词短语。判定标准是：删去扩展成分句子仍成立，删去转换后的核心成分句子则残缺。

sections.p: 定语扩展、状语扩展、并列扩展都只是在原有骨架上挂东西，句型名称不变。写长句的正确顺序是先定骨架，再逐层添加。
bullets: 定语扩展：The girl in red smiled.（仍为 SV）
状语扩展：When the bell rang, the girl in red smiled.（仍为 SV）
并列扩展：The girl in red smiled and waved.（并列谓语，仍为 SV）
三重叠加：When the bell rang, the girl in red smiled and waved at us.

sections.p: 转换必须保持逻辑关系不变，只换表达形式。四条通道覆盖了写作与改错中的绝大多数需要。
bullets: SVOO ↔ SVO + to/for 短语：He gave me a book. ↔ He gave a book to me.
SVOC ↔ 宾语从句：We found the plan workable. ↔ We found that the plan was workable.
定语从句 ↔ 分词/介词短语：the man who stood there ↔ the man standing there
状语从句 ↔ 非谓语/介词短语：Because he was ill, ... ↔ Being ill, ... / Because of his illness, ...

sections.p: 把从句压缩成非谓语时，非谓语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致；把从句改成介词短语时，从句的主语要变成介词宾语或所有格。这两条一旦违反，就产生悬垂修饰或成分残缺。
bullets: × Being ill, the meeting was postponed.（会议不会生病）
√ Because he was ill, the meeting was postponed.
√ Because of his illness, the meeting was postponed.
用分词替代定语从句时必须删去关系代词与 be 动词

examples.en: The students in the front row raised their hands.
examples.zh: 前排的学生举手了。
examples.note: in the front row 是定语扩展，核心仍是 SVO。

examples.en: After the lecture, the students asked several questions.
examples.zh: 讲座结束后，学生们提了几个问题。
examples.note: 介词短语作时间状语，属于状语扩展，核心句型不变。

examples.en: We found that the plan was workable.
examples.zh: 我们发现这个计划可行。
examples.note: SVOC 转换为宾语从句，workable 由宾补变为从句的表语。

examples.en: Having finished the report, she went home.
examples.zh: 写完报告后，她回家了。
examples.note: 状语从句压缩为完成式分词，动作先于主句发生，逻辑主语与主句一致。

examples.en: Being ill, the meeting was postponed.
examples.zh: 因为生病，会议被推迟了。
examples.note: 分词 being ill 的逻辑主语必须是主句主语，而会议不会生病，构成悬垂修饰，应改为 Because he was ill, ...

examples.en: The man who standing there is my teacher.
examples.zh: 站在那儿的那个人是我的老师。
examples.note: 用分词替代定语从句时须删去关系代词 who，改为 The man standing there...

examples.en: He gave the book to his sister.
examples.zh: 他把书给了妹妹。
examples.note: 由 SVOO 转换为 SVO + to 短语，意义不变。

pitfalls.wrong: Standing at the top of the hill, the whole city came into view.
pitfalls.right: Standing at the top of the hill, we could see the whole city.
pitfalls.why: 分词状语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，城市不会站在山顶上。

pitfalls.wrong: The girl who singing in the choir is my sister.
pitfalls.right: The girl singing in the choir is my sister.
pitfalls.why: 用分词短语替代定语从句时必须同时删去关系代词与 be 动词，只删 be 会留下残缺结构。

pitfalls.wrong: Although he was tired, but he kept working.
pitfalls.right: Although he was tired, he kept working.
pitfalls.why: although 与 but 都表让步转折，英语中一个分句只能用其中一个连接词。

contrast.diff: 扩展是在同一句型内加修饰或并列成分；并列句与复合句是把两个完整分句用连词组合，属于句层面的合并。

concept.mnemonic: 先立骨架再挂装饰；换位置是转换，加装饰是扩展。

core: 扩展 = 加定语、状语、并列成分，核心句型不变
转换 = 同一意义在句型间移动成分，逻辑关系必须保持
SVOO ↔ SVO + to/for 短语；SVOC ↔ 宾语从句
定语从句 → 分词短语时须删去关系代词与 be 动词
状语从句 → 非谓语时，逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致
review.trigger: 看到长句先删修饰语，剩下的主谓骨架决定句型，再检查转换后的逻辑主语

quickCheck.q: The girl in red smiled and waved 的核心句型是什么？
quickCheck.a: SV，in red 是定语，smiled and waved 是并列谓语。

quickCheck.q: We found the plan workable 转换成从句怎么写？
quickCheck.a: We found that the plan was workable.

quickCheck.q: Being ill, the meeting was postponed 错在哪里？
quickCheck.a: 分词逻辑主语与主句主语不一致，构成悬垂修饰。

drills.stem: ___ the report, she handed it to the manager without a word.
drills.explain: 完成式分词表示该动作先于主句动作发生，逻辑主语 she 与主句主语一致，是把 After she had finished the report 压缩后的形式。
drills.trap: Finished 是过去分词，与 she 构成被动关系，等于「她被完成」，语义不通。

drills.stem: ___ (walk) along the street, I met an old friend of mine.
drills.hint: 主句主语是 I，分词与它是主动关系。
drills.explain: 现在分词作时间状语，逻辑主语 I 与主句主语一致，相当于 While I was walking along the street。

drills.stem: The man who standing at the corner is our new coach.
drills.answer: The man standing at the corner is our new coach.
accept: The man standing at the corner is our new coach.
drills.explain: 用分词短语替代定语从句时，关系代词 who 与 be 动词要一并删去，只保留现在分词 standing。

drills.stem: 把下列词组连成一句通顺的话。
drills.answer: He gave the book to his sister.
drills.explain: 这是由 SVOO 转换而来的 SVO + to 短语结构，直接宾语 the book 提前，间接宾语由 to 引出。

drills.answer: Because she was ill, she did not come to class.
forbid: being ill, she was not come
drills.explain: 原因状语从句由 because 引导，从句主语 she 与主句主语一致；若改用介词短语，须写成 because of her illness，because of 后不能接句子。

options: but they finished it on time
however they finished it on time
so they finished it on time
drills.explain: although 已经承担让步关系，主句直接陈述结果即可，不再需要任何转折连词。
drills.trap: but 是汉语「虽然……但是」的直译叠加，英语中 although 与 but 不能出现在同一个句子里。
